name: Cameroon

flag.description: Three vertical stripes of green (hoist), red and yellow, with a yellow five-pointed star in the centre of the red stripe.
flag.symbolism: Green represents the forests of the south, yellow the savanna and sun of the north, and red unity; the star is the 'star of unity'.

hook: Cameroon puts red in the middle with a yellow star; Senegal puts yellow in the middle with a green star, and Mali has no star at all.
trivia: From 1961 to 1975 the flag had two stars, for the former French and British Cameroons; they became one when the federation ended.
Cameroon is nicknamed 'Africa in miniature' for its range of landscapes, from rainforest to desert to volcanic Mount Cameroon (about 4,040 m).
